background_prompt: Clean scenic production background from the approved radio concept; microphone left, glowing globe right, blue and amber studio; no text, frames, covers or static UI.
background_method: built-in imagegen; standard 1920x1080 JPEG package encoding
matching: Shared warderSongIdentity for metadata, lyrics and covers. Whole titles and credited rosters retained; explicitly sourced artist/recording aliases and numbered file tags repaired. No arbitrary partial, surname or first-result matching. TEST11 adds verified Kroky abbreviation, Stromy original title and Helena/Korn duet; inline featured credits and attached numeric full-artist tags repaired while preserving remix/live distinctions. TEST12 supports full-phrase unspaced separators and explicit spaced full-name slash credits; preserves hyphenated names and AC/DC.
state: Published production 1.0.39; update-production.json active after public byte verification.
header_revision: Owner requested: no central RADIO, localized weekday dd.mm.yyyy, smaller white seconds .SS adjacent to HH:MM and glyph bottoms aligned.
lyrics_scheduler: Recognized SK/CZ formats start Hudba.sk and LRCLIB together; global stations keep LRCLIB first. Other sources start after at most 750ms or an earlier primary completion. At most 33 logical source attempts, or 34 for the specifically scoped official recording, one per host at a time within the helper; 32s orchestration and 45s outer timeout. SuperMusic may perform one bounded public visitor validation per page; public session cookies are reused within its worker.
cover_revision: Owner requested compact frame tightly fitted to the cover; image aspect preserved, each axis at most 420 px; slot centre (526,496), equal to lyrics panel vertical centre. Static 440x720 left panel removed. Header-only sizing reads at most 64KiB in a worker; old artwork matcher and native async decoder retained. TEST10 additionally shares verified identities with lyrics and uses one bounded short-title catalogue fallback; complete artist/version verification remains mandatory.
owner_layout_acceptance: Owner accepted the compact radio layout in chat on 2026-10-28; this version changes no geometry or graphical assets.
absence_notice_filter: Exact known Hudba.sk absence notice is rejected during source and cache validation; complete real texts containing the same sentence remain valid.
retry_policy: Incomplete misses are marked partial and are not negatively cached; bounded automatic retries after 5, 20, 60 and 60 seconds, respecting longer host Retry-After. Complete misses stop. Valid TEST7/8/9/10/11/12 positive caches remain usable; older negative caches invalidated.

supermusic_transport: Normal site-provided FNV-1a visitor handshake, 100000 candidate / 0.4-second CPU cap; one validation hop, same-origin song destination, same-source redirects, 1 MiB response limit, original request time budget. Runs only inside the existing background helper.
receiver_validation: Owner confirmed TEST13 SuperMusic functional on the receiver on 29 October 2026. Production 1.0.39 retains that runtime and approved radio design, with version labels and release history updated. No exhaustive all-device test or separate physical installation of 1.0.39 is claimed.
